issue.title: Send a newsletter thread's web version to the bob ref reading queue

task_type_fields.proposal: For a bulletin-mode thread (newsletter: List-Unsubscribe, List-Id, Precedence: bulk, or a promotions/updates/forums category), offer to send its web version ("view in browser" link) to `bob ref` so it lands in the reading queue as a reference instead of (or beside) an inert mail note.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Deferred by plan:202611/bob_gmail.md §6 (epic bob-cli-hg). The epic only renders bulletins as text-and-links mail notes; routing them into bob ref crosses into the reference-ingest pipeline and needs its own scope.

issue.creation_reason: Filed by the bob-cli-hg land agent: plan:202611/bob_gmail.md §6 lists this as a deferred follow-up to file once the Gmail epic lands.

payload.description: Deferred follow-up from the Gmail epic plan §6; builds on what bob-cli-hg shipped
